For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry… –1 Samuel 15:23. Efforts to choose …a way which seemeth right unto a man… –Proverbs 14:12, leads to bondage, but choosing to walk in surrender and subjection leads to liberation and life.
